title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: front-of-room display defaults to attendee view in webinars and structured meetings
summary: The briefing passes: the attendee-view default, Teams Rooms Pro requirement and reported rollout dates match Microsoft's evidence. The rollout checklist names presenter-console switches that are not represented in the controls table; this is a minor consistency finding.

claims.claim: When a Teams Rooms on Android device joins a webinar or structured meeting as a presenter, the room display defaults to attendee view.
claims.quote: When a Teams Rooms on Android device is invited as a presenter in a Webinar or Structured Meeting, the front-of-room display defaults to the attendee view.

claims.claim: The attendee view lets in-room participants see the event as attendees would on their personal devices.
claims.quote: When you add an MTR as an attendee, attendees in the room will be able to see the event on the room display just as it would appear on their personal devices.
